literal: Do not forget the friendship of those free from blemish; do not abandon the friendship of those who became a support in distress.
translation: Never forget the friendship of those who are pure and free from blemish; never abandon the friendship of those who stood as your support in times of distress.
modern: குற்றமற்றவர்களுடைய நட்பை மறக்கக் கூடாது; துன்பம் வந்த காலத்தில் நமக்குத் துணையாக நின்றவர்களுடைய நட்பைக் கைவிடக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights two kinds of friendships that must be preserved at all costs. First, one must never forget the friendship of pure-hearted people who are free from faults (மாசற்றார் கேண்மை). Second, one must never forsake the friendship of those who acted as a pillar of support (துப்பு ஆயார்) during times of suffering (துன்பத்துள்). The word 'துப்பு' is used here in the sense of strength or support, which perfectly fits the context of receiving help during adversity.
